text: SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) is a leading private deemed university in India, established in 1976. It has over 60,000 full-time students and more than 4,460 faculty across all campuses, offering undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs in six faculties: Engineering & Technology, Management, Medicine & Health Sciences, Science & Humanities, Law, and Agricultural Sciences.

SRMIST campuses: Kattankulathur (KTR, Chennai - the main campus), Ramapuram (Chennai), Vadapalani (Chennai), Baburayanpettai (near Chennai), Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), and Delhi-NCR (Modinagar, Uttar Pradesh). The SRM group also includes separate universities: SRM University-AP (Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh), SRM University-Haryana (Sonepat) and SRM University-Sikkim (Gangtok).

The Kattankulathur (KTR) campus is the main SRMIST campus near Chennai, Tamil Nadu, spread over 248+ acres of green campus with about 49,777+ students. It has sports facilities for tennis, basketball, badminton, volleyball and more, plus a central library, hostels and labs.
SRMIST is accredited with the highest grade A++ (CGPA 3.55 out of 4.0) by NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council).
In NIRF 2025, SRMIST ranked 22nd overall and 11th among universities in India, and 25th in the Research category. In NIRF 2024 it held the 12th rank among Indian universities.

At the KTR campus, the B.Tech programs in Computer Science and Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering and Automobile Engineering carry international engineering accreditation listed on the SRMIST About page (IET).
SRMIST main phone numbers: +91-44-27417000 and +91-44-27417777. Official website: https://www.srmist.edu.in . Admissions information: https://www.srmist.edu.in/admission-india/ .

B.Tech and M.Tech admissions at SRMIST are through SRMJEEE (SRM Joint Engineering Entrance Examination), conducted by SRMIST. Admissions are on merit only, and the Directorate of Admissions is the only nodal office for all admissions.

SRMJEEE 2026 has three phases. Phase 1: apply by April 16, 2026, exam April 24-29, 2026. Phase 2: apply by June 4, 2026, exam June 10-15, 2026. Phase 3: apply by June 30, 2026, exam July 4-5, 2026. It is not mandatory to appear in all phases.

The SRMJEEE application fee is Rs. 1,400 for each phase and it is non-refundable. At the application stage only a photograph and signature image are required. Apply at https://applications.srmist.edu.in/btech .

For B.Tech programs in Biotechnology, Genetic Engineering and Biomedical Engineering the minimum aggregate is 60% in PCM / PMB / PCB (or Z = Botany or Zoology). Students who did not study Mathematics in 10+2 must take an additional 4-credit Mathematics course in first year.

SRMIST offers scholarships to SRMJEEE UG candidates based on performance (Phase I scholarships document is published for 2026). Candidates must meet the first-year B.Tech eligibility criteria and attending SRMJEEE counselling is mandatory to be awarded a scholarship.

The Kattankulathur campus has 14 hostels managed by the Directorate of SRMIST Hostels, with separate hostels for boys and girls, a mess, Wi-Fi and student amenities. Hostel booking is online and schedules are published per year of study.

Hostel fees include admission fee, room rent, amenities, electricity charges and mess fees. They must be paid online only and, once paid, hostel fees are not refunded. The amount depends on room type (for example AC or non-AC, number of sharing); exact current figures are in the Hostel Fees Structure circular on https://www.srmist.edu.in/srm-hostels/ .
SRM has sports and recreation facilities on campus with dedicated facilities for tennis, basketball, badminton, volleyball and other games, plus fitness facilities.

Placements are handled by the SRMIST Career Centre (phone +91-44-27455774), which hosts major recruiters including Fortune 500 companies and many core companies, and runs specialised training programs. See https://www.srmist.edu.in/career-centre/ .

Top recruiters reported by SRMIST include Amazon, PayPal, Google, Commvault, Morgan Stanley, VMware, Bajaj Finserv, Accolite, Toyota and EY GDS; high-package recruiters also include Wells Fargo, Adobe, Atlassian, Cisco, BNY Mellon and Nutanix. Core companies for ECE include Samsung, Qualcomm, Nokia, Siemens and Bosch.

Find the full list of programs (B.Tech, M.Tech, BBA, MBA, B.Sc, Law, Medicine, Agricultural Sciences, PhD and more) in the Program Finder: https://www.srmist.edu.in/program-finder/ . Departments are listed at https://www.srmist.edu.in/departments/ and faculty can be searched at https://www.srmist.edu.in/staff-finder/ .

MIST AI is a student-built virtual assistant for the SRM community. It answers from a curated SRM knowledge base using retrieval (embeddings) and Google Gemini, and says so when it is unsure. It was created by a team of CSE students at SRM IST. It is not an official SRMIST service, so always confirm fees and dates on https://www.srmist.edu.in .
